name: B10-0277/2025 – After § 6 – Am 8
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text: 6b.* Expresses its profound disapproval of the decision by the ArcelorMittal Group to cut up to 1 400 jobs in western Europe, including 637 in France, following the closure of the Reims and Denain sites and the loss of 135 jobs; expresses its concern about the 60 000 indirect jobs the company provides throughout France; expresses its concern about the loss of skills and autonomy in this strategic sector for European industry; deplores the plan to relocate support to India and Poland; recalls that the group made a profit of EUR 1.3 billion and paid out more than EUR 1.5 billion to its shareholders in 2024; recalls that, in recent years, ArcelorMittal has received several billion euro in public support from the EU through the European Regional Development Fund and from Member States; calls on the Commission to guarantee that Member States are able to do everything in their power, including sustained nationalisation, to protect jobs, skills and the European steel industry;
